author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 9; ensure at least four current turns classified as billing_refund across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer bought a desk lamp that arrived with a cracked base.

messages.content: My lamp just arrived and the base is cracked. I'm pretty disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you share a photo of the damage so we can look into it?
Sure, here's the photo. What happens next?
Thanks. Since it arrived damaged, we can send a replacement or issue a refund — your choice.

variants.text: I'd like the refund please, and can you confirm it goes back to my original card?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, forget the refund — just send me a new one.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hmm, wait — I also noticed the box had a different shipping label with someone else's name on it. Is that a concern?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer ordered a coffee maker two weeks ago and it was delivered yesterday.

messages.content: My coffee maker finally came yesterday. Thanks for the tracking updates.
You're welcome! Glad it arrived safely. Anything else I can help with?
Actually yes — the water reservoir has a weird plastic smell when I run it.
That can happen with new machines. Running a vinegar cycle usually clears it up. Want me to walk you through it?

variants.text: I tried the vinegar trick and it still smells. Can I return it for a refund?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: No, I'll try it again first. Thanks for the tip.
variants.label: general

variants.text: Before that — I never got the invoice email for this order. Can you resend it?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a smartwatch they received as a gift.

messages.content: I got a smartwatch as a gift but I don't have the receipt. Can I still get support?
We can look it up by serial number. Could you check the back of the watch or the box?
Found it — the serial is SW-8842-991. Does that help?
Perfect, I can see the warranty is active until March next year. What's the issue?

variants.text: The heart-rate monitor reads way off during workouts. Is that a known defect?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I'd rather just return it — the gifter said they'd take it back if I didn't like it. How does that work without a receipt?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Can you connect me to a real person? I've been going back and forth and I'm getting frustrated.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer purchased winter boots but the wrong size was sent.

messages.content: I ordered size 9 boots but the box says size 8.5.
Oh no, that's our mistake. Would you like an exchange or a refund?
Exchange, please. I need the 9s before my trip next Friday.
Understood. I'll set up the exchange with express shipping so it arrives by Wednesday.

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just refund me — I found the same boots cheaper elsewhere.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Great, thanks. Oh, and while you're at it, can you check if my account password was changed recently? I got a weird email.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Wait, I changed my mind — keep the exchange but also tell me if I can get a price adjustment since they're on sale now.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a blender that stopped working after two months.

messages.content: My blender just stopped spinning mid-smoothie. It's only two months old.
That's within the warranty period. Have you checked whether the base is properly locked into place?
Yes, it's locked. I also tried a different outlet. Nothing.
Thanks for checking. We can either repair it under warranty or replace it. Which do you prefer?

variants.text: Honestly, I just want my money back. This is the second blender that's failed on me.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Replace it, but can you make sure the new one ships to my office address this time?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: I don't know — what do you recommend? I use it daily for meal prep.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer ordered a bookshelf and is checking on delivery.

messages.content: Hi, I ordered a bookshelf on Monday. Any idea when it ships?
Let me check — it looks like it's scheduled to ship tomorrow from our Ohio warehouse.
Okay, good. And the delivery window is 3-5 business days after that, right?
Correct, so you should see it by early next week. I'll keep an eye on it for you.

variants.text: Perfect, thanks for confirming. Have a great day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I need to cancel it — I'm moving and won't have space for it anymore.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: One more thing — the payment went through twice on my statement. Can you sort that out?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase and wants to discuss options.

messages.content: The vase I ordered arrived shattered. Completely in pieces.
That's terrible — I apologize. We'll make this right. Would you like a replacement or a refund?
I'm leaning toward a replacement since it's a gift for my mom's anniversary.
Of course. I can expedite a replacement so it arrives in time. Shall I proceed?

variants.text: Yes, go ahead with the replacement. And please double-check the packaging this time.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, no — my mom said she'd rather pick something herself. Just refund me.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hold on, I also want to file a complaint about the delivery company. Who handles that?
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer bought a yoga mat that has a strong chemical odor.

messages.content: The yoga mat I got reeks of chemicals. I aired it out for three days and it's still strong.
That's unusual for our mats. Could you tell me the batch number printed on the label?
It says B-2207. Does that tell you anything?
Thanks — that batch had a known adhesive issue. We've flagged it for recall. We can offer a full refund or a swap for a different model.

variants.text: I'll take the refund. Also, should I be worried about health effects from using it?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Swap me to the cork model instead. Is that one free of the adhesive problem?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Can I speak to a supervisor about this? I want to make sure the recall is properly documented.
variants.label: human_service
